author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0009097 isoleucine biosynthetic process and D-leucine biosynthetic process (no exp annotations)

https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/30848

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17wu2d7ytP3zsIDOmMLpv4GuM4QstLshdQLhkHwBm7oU/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 
CGD 2
EcoCyc 7
EcoliWiki 2
~MTBBASE 1~
~PomBase 2~ DONE
~SGD 2~ DONE
~TAIR 2 ~
~UniProt 2~

GO:0009097 isoleucine biosynthetic process is an unnecessary grouping term and will be replaced with GO:1901705 L-isoleucine biosynthetic process

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0009097 isoleucine boisynthetic process

author: mlkaldunski
body:
The announcement indicates that "The reason for obsoletion is that more specific terms were created.". Can you list them? 
I've been digging around in the ontology and I'm not sure what would be an appropriate replacement. 
The "metabolic process" terms, the parent term, were obsoleted in an earlier ticket, in favor of the more specific "catabolic process" and "biosynthetic process" terms. But now the isoleucine catabolic process term is to be obsoleted. 
I don't agree that "isoleucine catabolic process" should be replaced as stated above : "This is an unnecessary grouping term and will be replaced with GO:1901705 L-isoleucine biosynthetic process". I can only think it's meant the D-leucine biosynthetic process should be replaced with that (except it indicates there are no annotations to the D term).
